# aikido_aws_cloud (Resource)

Connects an AWS cloud environment to Aikido, either as a single account or as an AWS Organization management account. Create the IAM role in AWS first (see the Aikido AWS cloud documentation); this resource does not generate CloudFormation or console links. Use aikido_team_resource to link the resulting cloud to a team.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Single AWS account. Create the IAM role in AWS first (see Aikido AWS cloud docs).
resource "aikido_aws_cloud" "production" {
  name        = "AWS production"
  role_arn    = "arn:aws:iam::000000000000:role/aikido-security-readonly"
  environment = "production"
}

# Full AWS Organization via the management account role.
resource "aikido_aws_cloud" "organization" {
  name        = "AWS organization"
  role_arn    = "arn:aws:iam::111111111111:role/aikido-security-readonly"
  environment = "mixed"

  organization = {
    organization_id        = "o-1234567890"
    synced_unit_ids        = ["r-abcd"]
    excluded_accounts      = ["222222222222"]
    container_scan_enabled = true
    vm_scan_enabled        = false
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment` (String) Environment purpose used for severity weighting. One of production, staging, development, mixed.
- `name` (String) Display name for this cloud connection.
- `role_arn` (String) IAM role ARN that Aikido assumes to scan this AWS account. Create the role before applying (see Aikido AWS cloud docs). Updatable only for single-account connections; changing it on an organization-linked cloud forces replacement.

### Optional

- `organization` (Attributes) When set, connects this AWS account as an organization management account and syncs member accounts. Adding or removing this block forces replacement. synced_unit_ids and excluded_accounts are updatable; organization_id and the ECR/EBS scan flags are create-only. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--organization))

### Read-Only

- `external_id` (String) AWS account ID extracted from the role ARN.
- `id` (String) Aikido cloud ID.
- `last_scanned_at` (Number) Unix timestamp of the last cloud scan, or -1 when no scan has completed yet.

<a id="nestedatt--organization"></a>
### Nested Schema for `organization`

Required:

- `organization_id` (String) AWS Organizations ID, for example o-1234567890. Changing it forces replacement.
- `synced_unit_ids` (List of String) Root ID (r-...) or Organization Unit IDs (ou-...) to sync. Provide the root ID to connect the entire organization.

Optional:

- `container_scan_enabled` (Boolean) When true, automatically configure ECR scanning across the organization. Defaults to false. Create-only; changing it forces replacement.
- `excluded_accounts` (List of String) Optional AWS account IDs to exclude from organization sync. Defaults to an empty list.
- `vm_scan_enabled` (Boolean) When true, automatically configure EBS/EC2 scanning across the organization. Defaults to false. Create-only; changing it forces replacement.

Read-Only:

- `is_management_account` (Boolean) True when this cloud is the management account of a connected AWS Organization.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/bin/sh
# Import an existing Aikido AWS cloud by its numeric cloud ID.
terraform import aikido_aws_cloud.example 12345
```
